Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Interactive PvP combat frames, reliable held-action scheduling, LB cues, and survival helpers.
Description: A local PvP HUD with fixed Self/S1-S5 combat frames, optional exact row targeting and mouseover, calibrated LB gauges, direct ally LB damage, pressure and CC cues, a bounded held-action scheduler, reactive counter-CC, survival and job helpers, low-MP Focus, assists, team communication, and target highlights.
Changelog: Moves every job-specific physical-hold helper into the second priority tier immediately after Purify, in deterministic urgency order: reactive WHM Miracle / BRD Silent Nocturne, Ally Rescue, PLD Guardian, NIN Seiton, SCH Critical Strategy, then DRK Hiebsprung. Reactive counter-CC leads ally cleanse because its LB and protection-end windows are shorter; Smart Recuperate and the generic helpers now follow that tier. Simultaneous post-Purify/post-Guard selection treats only fresh positive pressure as a ranking bonus. Zero, unknown, or stale pressure is neutral and never gates a candidate; HP, trusted MP, and stable identity decide the remaining order. Schema 30 and all existing settings are preserved.
